_comment: Timing/memory measurement only for plain CTC: same model, data and optimizer settings as ctc.json with a fixed small budget of 200 updates and one dev evaluation at the end. Read seconds_per_update_excluding_dev, dev_eval_seconds and peak GPU memory from run.json to choose max_steps for ctc.json. Its checkpoint is not a baseline result.
architecture: conv2d x2 (stride 2) + BiLSTM 4x320 + linear CTC head
primary_sources: Graves et al. (2006), Connectionist Temporal Classification, ICML
Amodei et al. (2016), Deep Speech 2, ICML
